newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Bomb explodes outside Turkish embassy in Brussels.
newsitem.headline: Bomb explodes outside Turkish embassy in Brussels.

text.p: A bomb exploded outside the Turkish embassy in Belgium's capital, Brussels, on Saturday, blowing out windows in nearby buildings but injuring no one.
"It appears a car drew up and a man threw a rucksack containing the device against the embassy. A minute later it exploded," a police spokesman told Reuters.
The Turkish embassy, which has reinforced windows, was only slightly damaged in the attack in the early hours of the morning.
An anonymous telephone caller to an international news agency claimed the bomb was planted by an Armenian group and was the start of a wider terror campaign.
"From July 1, 1997, all Turkish institutions and travel agencies all over the world will be our targets. This is our last warning," he said.
The man, speaking poor English, claimed to represent an Armenian military group called Kourken Yanikian, named after an Armenian who died in Los Angeles in the United States in 1973.

He said the attack was carried out because Turkey continued to neglect international law and treaties after carrying out genocide against Armenians. Christian Armenia says 1.5 million Armenians were massacred by Turks in 1915, but Turkey says this figure is grossly exaggerated.
"(Turkey) continues to conduct an expansionist, terrorist policy against all peace loving nations of the Balkans and Middle East," he said.
The committee of Armenians living in Belgium said in a statement later on Saturday the claim was "suspect" and added that the Armenian diaspora had long renounced violence.
"The claim made in the name of the Armenians lacks any legitimacy and is suspect to say the least," the committee's president Michel Mahmourian said.
Belgian police said they had no information about who carried out the attack.
The embassy was cordoned off by police. Glass from nearby buildings, which included a restaurant, littered the pavement.
Charles Verpoorten, manager of a news agency in one of the damaged buildings, said that at the time of the blast no one was in the restaurant which usually closes at 10 p.m. (2000 GMT).
